bio: Evelise is a tactics prodigy – she was outfoxing her father at board games by age ten, and spent her teens crushing mages and generals alike. Now an adult, she has graduated to Legion attache, advising soldiers and kings. There the wars are no game, but she remains as ruthless a player as ever.
